page_title: Free Online Video Maker and Editor Tools

summary.name: Vimeo Create
summary.one_liner: Vimeo Create is a browser-based video maker and editor with templates, a drag-and-drop timeline, in-browser recording, and interactive video features.
use_cases: create product ads and promo videos from templates
record video messages, demos, and tutorials in a browser
edit videos by removing filler words from transcript
add clickable hotspots and CTAs to videos
resize videos for social platforms like TikTok
write and read AI-generated scripts with a teleprompter
summary.what_it_does: Vimeo Create lets users record, script, edit, and add interactivity to videos using templates and a drag-and-drop timeline editor. It offers a text-based editor that removes filler words, trimming, branding and custom font support, and aspect ratio resizing for formats such as TikTok. Users can record directly in a web browser without downloads, use an AI script generator with a teleprompter, and add clickable hotspots, overlays, quizzes and polls. The page states that it is for beginners and professionals and requires no coding.
notable: Text-based video editor that removes filler words from the transcript
Browser-based recording with AI script generator and teleprompter
Clickable hotspots, add-to-cart CTAs and overlays for interactive video
LMS compatibility for integrating videos into existing platforms
caveats: Feature availability varies; the page refers to a separate pricing page for details
Vimeo offers discounts to US-based non-profits and educational institutions, implying other users may pay
Some features are marked as new and their availability is not fully specified
